title: Table
author: DeepBuild
description: Table(rows, row_labels, col_labels) as a frame@1 grid whose cells each hold their entry as text@1, the tracks h_buff and v_buff apart and as wide as their widest cell, with the grid's rules between tracks (lines: inner), around it (outer), or both. a unit is the frame's short side ÷ 8 in u (fw, fh), so the frame is 14.22 × 8 units at 16:9; y flips and the origin moves to the frame's center; radians become degrees; a stroke width w becomes w × unit ÷ 100 u; font_size f is an em of f ÷ 96 units.

rows.about: rows: the entries, row by row, as text

row_labels.about: row_labels: one per row, down the left

col_labels.about: col_labels: one per column, along the top

top_left_entry.about: the corner entry when both labels are written

lines.about: lines: rules between tracks, around the table, or both

h_buff.about: the gap between columns, in units

v_buff.about: the gap between rows, in units

font_size.about: the entries' font size: an em of font_size ÷ 96 units

move_to.about: move_to: the table's center, in units

color.about: the entries' and rules' color; unwritten, the ink role

stroke_width.about: the rules' width, w × unit ÷ 100 u

entry.when: !(floor(k / nc) < lc && k % nc < lr) || top_left_entry != blank

params.text: cat(r < lc ? (c < lr ? top_left_entry : col_labels[c - lr]) : (c < lr ? row_labels[r - lc] : rows[r - lc][c - lr]))

refuses.include_outer_lines: Write lines: outer or both instead.
refuses.line_config: Write color and stroke_width: rules take the table's.
refuses.element_to_mobject: Leave it out: entries are text@1; for formulas use math.matrix with vector@1 entries.
refuses.add_background_rectangles_to_entries: Leave it out, or place a rect@1 onto each cell.
refuses.arrange_in_grid_config: Leave it out: cells center in their tracks.
refuses.use_vectorized: Leave it out: every math@1 shape is a path the renderer strokes and fills on its own.
refuses.sheen_factor: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.sheen_direction: Leave it out: a flat fill has no sheen; use a gradient fill through the look.
refuses.background_stroke_width: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.background_stroke_color: Leave it out, or draw a second, wider copy beneath in the background color.
refuses.joint_type: Leave it out: paths join by the look's line style.
refuses.cap_style: Leave it out: paths cap by the look's line style.
refuses.shade_in_3d: Leave it out: 2D shapes draw flat; for a lit shape use math.surface.
